anchor_resolution.version_in_original_question: v16 and v17; exact editions unspecified
anchor_resolution.method: Existing derivation searched available TS 38.101 parts 1–5 for the quoted PC1.5 wording, and located it in the Rel-16 snapshot of part 1.
anchor_resolution.interpretation: The observed snapshots establish presence/absence in these editions. The requester’s exact compared editions are unspecified.

supported_subquery.question: Which Rel-17 change requests that modify clause 6.2.1 of TS 38.101-1 have a source-verified RAN4 disposition for the whole document and were submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack? Give each document, its disposition, the RAN4 meeting, and the CR pack document number.

sql.cr_side: SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, g.label, p.pack_number FROM cr_modifies_section c JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id JOIN document doc ON doc.id = c.cr JOIN disposition d ON d.target = c.cr JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = c.cr JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE c.section_id = :anchor AND doc.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
sql.container_side: SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, g.label, p.pack_number FROM section_modified_by c JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id JOIN document doc ON doc.id = c.cr JOIN disposition d ON d.target = c.cr JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id JOIN pack_member m ON m.cr = c.cr JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE c.section_id = :anchor AND doc.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'

cypher_from_existing_derivation: MATCH (:Section {sectionId: $anchor})<-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]-(cr) MATCH (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(release:Release) WHERE $anchor CONTAINS ('-' + release.releaseName + '-') MATCH (cr)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) -[:DISPOSITION_OF]->(:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"' MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber, d.dispositionCode, m.meetingNumber, p.crPackId
